narrative: The technology landscape is rapidly evolving with significant strides in consumer devices and AI. Apple and Tesla are pushing boundaries with innovative products like the foldable iPhone Duo and a flying Roadster, while new AI models from Google, OpenAI, and Meta are democratizing advanced capabilities. Beyond consumer tech, the scientific community is achieving breakthroughs in medical treatments and space exploration, complemented by critical infrastructure developments from Cloudflare and AWS, all contributing to a dynamic and interconnected technological future.

highlights.title: The first vibe-coded gun is here
highlights.whyItMatters: The emergence of an AI-designed 3D-printed firearm raises significant concerns about untraceable weapons and the evolving ethics of AI in manufacturing.

highlights.title: The iPhone Duo is now available to preorder at $1,999
highlights.whyItMatters: Apple's entry into the foldable phone market with the iPhone Duo marks a significant shift in mobile technology, potentially setting new design and pricing benchmarks.

highlights.title: The Tesla Roadster flew, drove upside down, and hit 60mph in under a second
highlights.whyItMatters: Tesla's demonstration of a flying Roadster with extreme performance pushes the boundaries of electric vehicle capabilities and Musk's ambitious promises.

highlights.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
highlights.whyItMatters: Meta's collaboration with Apple to bring an open-weight AI model to Macs signifies a push towards more accessible and localized AI development.

highlights.title: Time is a-changin’: say goodbye to the leap second
highlights.whyItMatters: The International Bureau of Weights and Measures' decision to scrap the leap second aims to prevent potential infrastructure failures, impacting global timekeeping standards.

highlights.title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
highlights.whyItMatters: Rivian's integration of AI agents into its vehicles indicates a future where automotive experiences are increasingly personalized and automated, potentially enhancing driving and passenger interactions.

highlights.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
highlights.whyItMatters: Google's release of Gemini 4 Argon provides developers, enterprises, and scientists with a powerful frontier model for complex problem-solving.

highlights.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
highlights.whyItMatters: GPT-6.1 Sol offers near-Astra intelligence at a lower cost, making advanced AI more accessible for coding and professional applications.

topics.name: Technology
topics.summary: New foldable phones, high-performance electric vehicles, and AI-generated firearms are reshaping consumer products and ethical debates.

topics.name: AI
topics.summary: Major advancements in AI models like Google's Gemini 4 Argon and OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol are enhancing capabilities for developers, enterprises, and everyday applications, while Meta expands local AI for Macs.

topics.name: Science
topics.summary: Breakthroughs in medical implants and space exploration continue, with NASA planning missions to Mars' moons and observing climate phenomena.

topics.name: Infrastructure
topics.summary: Cloudflare introduces new developer tools and observability platforms, while AWS expands serverless functions and S3 capabilities.

topics.name: Developer
topics.summary: New programming languages and tools like Deno and Haiku emulators are emerging, alongside efforts to improve Git infrastructure for agent-scale development.
